name: The Absent Minded Prospector
objectiveText: Travel south and check on Prospector Remtravel .

comments.body:
From Auberdine, travel south past the Grove of the Ancients until you come to The Master's Glaive. It's filled with lvl 18s but you can simply walk around it. To the west of the Master's Glaive, you'll find Remtravel's Excavation. I found Remtravel right at the entrance to the excavation.

The excavation has a lot of annoying 19s & 20s. The quest you get from Remtravel is to accompany him around the excavation while he looks for his underwear or something... Not a solo unless you're 20+ but could be done by 2 16-19s. Very annoying but 1150XP for finding Remtravel & lots more later in the series.

When you get to the excavation, just ask if anyone might be willing to help you. If you're on a busy server, there will probably be someone near doing another quest (in the Grove of the Ancients there are about 3 or 4). Worked for me.
35,84 for those with coords!

Go south towards Ashenvale.  See the map below.

[npc=2917]
Found him @ 35.83
Even if you can skip to Step 2, this step is worth 1150xp basically just for finding the guy. So I wouldn't recommend missing out on that.
If you're coming from Auberdine, the excavation (called Remtravel's Excavation), is on your right side, the west side - closer to the sea.
WEST of the Temple of the Moon.. I spent soooo long searching for him east.. got me annoying :P

The key is to start not from the miner but from the other side of the pit. After slaughtering all the wood/stone robots, you can talk to the miner and then it's easy for two ppl to guard the old guy around the pit when he is studying the thing.
replies:
This may have worked for you but it did not work for me.  I killed everything in the pit but they respawned with a quickness once I started the quest.  I had grouped with a buddy and things were going pretty smoothly until the second set respawned and the prospector was overtaken.  

I think starting the quest resets the mobs.  Just my observation.
I second this. I tried to clear out the area of mobs first, but not only did they respawn incredibly fast, but some mobs only show up to attack while the dwarf is actually walking around the place.

comments.body:
I failed this quest, so abandoned it and headed back to Hollee. However, can't get the quest from him now. :( How can I retake it? Is the only way to join a group that already have the quest? Or will even that work?

P.

If you're a healer type, I imagine that you can keep the prospector healed.  However, I'm a solo Hunter (level 22) and failed the first time even though I had gone through the site beforehand and killed off all the golems.  The problem was the ambushes by the Gnolls (or whatever) when the prospector entered the tents and other spaces while looking for his fossil.  Two level 20s jumped out at him and one of them killed him while my pet was drawing aggro from the other.

The golems respawn so fast that by the time you clear out the camp, they have already started respawning again.

So unless you can heal or are very lucky, I recommend a group.
